# Climate Wavers

> Disaster alert verification and climate action platform from FlowOps Africa in Nairobi, Kenya.

Climate Wavers publishes live USGS earthquake and NASA EONET events, hosts tree-planting campaigns, and builds toward verified alerts that do not amplify rumor as fact.
